decord 0.6.0+nre4 - statement of changes (Apache License 2.0, section 4(b))

This wheel is built from decord v0.6.0 (https://github.com/dmlc/decord, Apache License 2.0)
via an NVIDIA fork at commit
3bb314828c626d7c33e4f84a85772593fce7ea40. The upstream LICENSE is retained in this dist-info
directory. The files below were modified by NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, 2026. This file is
the statement of changes; the modified files themselves carry no in-file notice.

Fork commits over upstream v0.6.0 (cmake/util/FindFFmpeg.cmake only, an aarch64 library layout
that the patch below then replaces; the net change to that file is a comment).

Changes applied by the NuRec build (decord-0.6.0-ffmpeg-9.patch):
- cmake/util/FindFFmpeg.cmake: one Linux FFMPEG_LIBRARIES layout for all architectures.
- src/video/ffmpeg/ffmpeg_common.h: restored #include <libavcodec/bsf.h>.
- src/video/ffmpeg/filter_graph.cc: buffer sink created with avfilter_graph_alloc_filter and the
  pixel_formats option (FFmpeg 7+); added pixdesc.h include.
- src/video/video_reader.cc: const AVCodec*, av_packet_side_data_get (FFmpeg 7+).
- src/audio/audio_reader.cc: AVChannelLayout API in place of channels/channel_layout; removed
  avcodec_close (FFmpeg 7+).
- python/decord/_ffi/libinfo.py: __version__ stamped with the +nre4 local version at build time.

Build differences that are not source changes: the native library is compiled against a shared
LGPL FFmpeg 9.0.1 built with --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree and bundled into decord.libs/ by
auditwheel (the upstream PyPI wheel bundles FFmpeg 4.1.6 with libx264); the LGPL notice
decord.libs/LICENSE.ffmpeg-LGPL is added.
